headlines.title: Duffy details timeline of ground stop, demands more FAA funding
headlines.description: Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy gives the timeline of the paralyzing FAA ground stop, which left travelers across the country stranded for hours. Duffy says the issue was due to old communications systems.

headlines.title: Trump, Xi and Putin plan an unprecedented meeting on the sidelines of APEC, officials say
headlines.description: President Donald Trump will meet with the leaders of China and Russia on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzen, China’s tech hub, next week, an unprecedented gathering of the heads of the world’s biggest nuclear powers.

headlines.title: All accounted for after tanker crashes into New Orleans riverboat
headlines.description: More than 100 passengers and crew were rescued after a tanker struck a river cruise on the Mississippi River in New Orleans, prompting a massive rescue operation that sent 32 people to the hospital. NBC News’ George Solis reports.

headlines.title: SpaceX historic test flight takes off
headlines.description: One of the few flights taking off tonight was SpaceX's Starship rocket. How were they allowed to do that, and what’s the goal of the mission? NBC News’ Gadi Schwartz reports.

headlines.title: Commerce Secretary Lutnick agrees to testify about Nvidia
headlines.description: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick agreed to testify before Congress over national security concerns regarding the expanding Nvidia scandal. NBC News’ Yamiche Alcindor details bipartisan concern and White House reaction.

headlines.title: Trump administration delays Medicaid work requirements by six months
headlines.description: Work requirements were set to go into effect on Jan. 1 for many able-bodied adults who receive Medicaid, which could have left millions without health insurance.

headlines.title: U.S. measles deaths rise to 10 after new reports in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin
headlines.description: Total measles deaths in the United States this year rose to 10 on Friday, a grim milestone in an outbreak that has seen a record number of infections and prompted state and local health departments to ramp up vaccination efforts.

headlines.title: Rep. Lauren Boebert, conservative firebrand from Colorado, loses her race for re-election
headlines.description: The Colorado Republican changed to a more conservative district after a close re-election call in 2022. But this year’s blue tsunami has swept her out of office, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Microsoft scrambles to recover after massive outage
headlines.description: The company says it doesn’t have a timeline for a full recovery and blamed a “technical issue” for the outage, saying it was not the result of a cyberattack or artificial intelligence. NBC News’ Christine Romans reports.

headlines.title: As AI looms over Hollywood, Oscar hopefuls make the case for human craft
headlines.description: In this week’s ON THE LOT, we’re looking at Universal’s “Odyssey” Oscar push, Skydance’s next chapter and Sofia Franklyn’s “Daddy Issues.”

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.
